CustomMetadata.label: Volunteers: rows leave with the account

values.value: Deleting a person account, household or organization deletes the volunteer requirements and volunteer skills that name it or any of its contacts, whoever deletes it, so a background check never outlives its person. Merging a duplicate keeps them: the merge moves them to the record kept. Restoring from the Recycle Bin does not bring them back. This automation enforces a rule, so it cannot be switched off here and pausing automation does not suspend it.
